lines.text: One editor. One idea. One hundred videos.
Sounds impossible. It isn't. Here's why.
When an edit is code, every choice is a setting. The text. The music. The language. The length.
Change a setting, and you get a new video.
Ten hooks to test. Five languages. Three formats. Multiply them, and one project becomes a hundred and fifty videos.
The old way? Every version is a new edit, by hand.
The vibe editing way? One template, and a list.
That's how small teams are starting to post like big studios. Follow for more vibe editing.
